assessment: The official Nalanda portal ties land records and revenue administration to Biharsharif. Its district map page provides constituency/block maps, not parcel features. State land-record pages expose identifier-driven records; no plot/owner query was submitted.
registryAssessment: Nalanda District’s official government portal lists online Khata/Jamabandi land-record services and identifies the Revenue Section at the Biharsharif Collectorate. This is local district/city land-record administration. Available district maps are administrative/electoral rather than parcel geometry; no personal or plot lookup was made.
